ring.$description:
Keyboard focus indicator: a two-colour ring drawn outside the element's edge — a band of color-focus.ring-inner wrapped in a band of color-focus.ring, each border-width.focus wide. Fixed across viewport; varies by brand and theme through its two colours. The outer band reaches 3:1 against color-surface.static.primary and secondary, and the inner band, the colour of color-surface.static.primary, keeps it apart from a strong fill of the same colour.

Used in:
The focused state of every interactive component. It follows the element's corner radius and takes no part in layout: a spread drop-shadow pair in Figma; in code the outer band is drawn as an outline, so focus survives forced-colors mode.

Do not:
Do not rebuild it from its parts or swap a band for a translucent tint — the 3:1 needs the outer band opaque. Do not use an elevation.* style for focus; elevation.raised and elevation.floating are depth, not state. Do not rely on the outer band alone on a surface other than color-surface.static.primary or secondary — check the ring against that surface.

ring-inset.$description:
Keyboard focus indicator drawn inside the element's edge, the inset counterpart of focus.ring: a band of color-focus.ring along the edge with a band of color-focus.ring-inner inside it, each border-width.focus wide. Fixed across viewport; varies by brand and theme through its two colours. The edge band reaches 3:1 against the inner band and against color-surface.static.primary and secondary; check it against any other fill next to it. The two bands take 4px inside the element.

Used in:
The focused state of an element that sits flush with its neighbours inside a container that clips — menu items, list rows, draggable list items, table cells — where a ring outside the edge would be cut off or would cover the next item. It follows the element's corner radius and takes no part in layout: an inner-shadow pair in Figma; in code the edge band is drawn as an outline with a negative offset, so focus survives forced-colors mode.

Do not:
Do not use it on a standalone control with room around it, or on an element with less than 4px of inner padding — that is focus.ring. Do not rebuild it from its parts or swap a band for a translucent tint — the 3:1 needs the edge band opaque. Do not use an elevation.* style for focus.
